question: The dividends received by the Government from Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) are ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**non-tax revenue receipts.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dividends** received by the **Government** from **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)** are considered as **non-tax revenue receipts.**
 
• **Non-tax revenue** receipts are the revenue generated by the government through means other than taxes, such as **dividends, profits, fees, and fines.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capital expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred by the government for the **creation of assets** such as buildings, machinery, etc.

 
 
• Capex is mostly a **one-time investment** in **non-consumable assets** used to support a company's future expansion and preserve current operating levels.
 
 
 
• **Capital receipts** are the receipts of the government that lead to an increase in its** assets and liabilities,** such as borrowings, disinvestment, and recovery of loans.
 
 
• They also make mention of **cash inflows.**
 
• Both **debt and non-debt receipts** are considered capital receipts.
 
 
 
• **Tax revenue receipts** are the revenue generated by the government through taxes such as** income tax, GST, etc. **
 
 
• They come from either **indirect or direct taxes**.
 
• It is the primary source of the **government's regular revenue.****​**
